claims.evidence: The witness report lacks a front view or any measurements to confirm the screen size.
No brand logo or manufacturer sticker was visible in the provided photo of the rear.
Internal component failure cannot be diagnosed through external photos.

risks.risk: The screen may be cracked or severely scratched.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the front of the television while turned off.
risks.if_unproven: As having a shattered or unusable tube.

risks.risk: The internal copper components (yoke/transformer) may have been scavenged.
risks.proof: A video showing the internal components or a photo through the ventilation slats with better lighting.
risks.if_unproven: As a hollow shell for scrap plastic.

risks.risk: The actual screen size is smaller than claimed (e.g., 21-inch or 14-inch).
risks.proof: A photo of the front with a measuring tape across the diagonal.
risks.if_unproven: As the smallest standard CRT size (14-inch).

proof_requests: A well-lit photo of the front of the TV.
A clear photo of the manufacturer's sticker on the back showing the model number.
A photo of the input ports (AV/RF) to check for damage.
response.reason: The witness only provided a dark photo of the rear. Without a front view or a model sticker, the size, brand, and screen integrity—which determine even scrap value—cannot be established.
